newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama Canal transits drop due to tug boat sinkage.
newsitem.headline: Panama Canal transits drop due to tug boat sinkage.

text.p: Panama Canal Commission (PCC) officials are investigating the sinkage of a commercial tug boat in one of its Pacific Coast locks, the PCC said in a statement released late Thursday.

"Average daily transits through the canal are 38 to 39. There were 33 ships waiting at midnight Monday and Tuesday, and the wait could increase on average of five to six vessels per day," the PCC said.
The time expected to remove and salvage the tug boat San Pablo II is 10 days, the PCC said.
The tug boat sank Monday afternoon while assisting Boskalis International b.v. in dredging work and has been blocking the southeast side of Miraflores locks, the PCC said.
